sn47.37:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpi sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato yo kāyasmiṃ chando so pahīyati || chandassa pahānāya amataṃ sacchikataṃ hoti
sn47.37:4.1: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato yo dhammesu chando so pahīyati || chandassa pahānā amatam sacchikataṃ hotī ti || ||
